description: This Java class 'RoleEditor' extends PropertyEditorSupport to facilitate serialization and deserialization of 'Role' objects for Spring's data binding, enabling conversion between Role objects and String representations (name or uuid). It includes methods to set the Role property from text input and retrieve its string form.

classes.name: RoleEditor
classes.description: Custom property editor for Role objects, supporting conversion from text (name or UUID) to Role instances and vice versa.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Converts a string (name or UUID) into a Role object and sets it as the value.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Returns the string representation (role name) of the current Role object.
